title: Hi I'm Corey Tuesday Mix
style: 110 bpm, electro-pop indie pop, warm confident male lead with NZ AU lean, light rap-flow verses, soaring melodic choruses, acoustic guitar strums into sparkling synths, four-on-the-floor kick, handclap backbeats, layered backing vocals, call and response, bright major key, friendship anthem, emotional build-ups
lyrics:
[Intro - soft acoustic guitar, gentle pulse, warm reverb]
Thinking 'bout what you're thinking 'bout me
You're doing the same, yeah, we both see
Hi, I'm Corey — nice to meet you
The hard part's done — the rest is easy

[Verse 1 - Male, light rap flow over acoustic]
First step's the only step that's hard
Everything after just unfolds the card
No overthinking, no rehearsing the line
Just a simple hi and the moment is fine
Dad said the rest of them are only humans
Practicing all day to get that focused glow
Focus on you and what you're naturally good at
That's the whole secret — you already know

[Pre-Chorus - layered backing vocals]
Easy deep breath, keep it straight and true
Drop the assumptions, let the real you through
Everyone's waiting for the brave first move
Say hi, flash a smile, watch the magic prove

[Chorus - soaring, sparkling synths, four-on-the-floor, handclaps]
Hi, I'm Corey — nice to meet you!
Nothing more, nothing less — the hard part's done!
Assumptions dropped — communication's begun!
Let's play another day — how 'bout Tuesday?
Hi, I'm Corey — nice to meet you!
Let the good times roll — me and you!
See you Tuesday — we'll make some plans
New friends, new chapters — across the lands

[Verse 2 - light rap, bouncy]
City streets or coffee shops or online feeds
We're all craving that real human need
To laugh, to share, to build something true
Just drop the guard and say a simple how do you do
From the park bench to the late-night ride
Doesn't matter where, the method don't hide
Be the first, own the moment, write your name
Strangers into stories — that's the whole game

[Spoken Motivational Break - confident over building beat]
Corey, what? Say hello to everyone in the room.
Ok. Got it. Onto it now. No fear.

[Final Chorus - big build, full layered]
Hi, I'm Corey — nice to meet you!
Nothing more, nothing less — the hard part's done!
Wanna be friends? Let's make it fun!
Let's play another day — how 'bout Tuesday?
Barriers breaking in the best way!
Hi, I'm Corey — nice to meet you!
Let the good times roll — me and you!

[Outro - soft fade with layered harmonies, acoustic returns]
Good to meet you... good to meet you...
Good to meet you.
Hi — I wish that whenever you wish,
Your wishes come true.
Bye.
See you on Tuesday.
